verdict.rationale: A browsable skills/plugins registry with one-command or one-click install is a fair axis for an AI assistant like Khoj, so the story applies. The evidence shows only custom agents configured in the admin panel, data-source integrations (Notion, GitHub) and client apps. None of these is a registry of installable capabilities, so they are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a power user, I can browse a real skills/plugins registry and install a capability with one command or click
